card.line: Tarshish was a far-off place across the sea, known for its ships and rich cargo, and it is where Jonah tried to run when he fled from the LORD.

moments.title: Ships named for Tarshish
moments.text: King Solomon had ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram's fleet. Once every three years they arrived bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

moments.title: Ships built for Tarshish
moments.text: Jehoshaphat agreed to make ships to go to Tarshish, and they were built in Ezion-geber. The LORD destroyed his works, and the ships were wrecked and could not sail to Tarshish.

moments.title: Jonah sails for Tarshish
moments.text: Jonah got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa, found a ship bound for Tarshish, paid the fare, and went aboard.

moments.title: Daughter of Tarshish
moments.text: Isaiah spoke against Tyre and called to the Daughter of Tarshish. He said there was no longer a harbor.

moments.title: Ships of Tarshish in the lead
moments.text: God says the islands will wait for Him, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead. The ships will bring children from afar, with their silver and gold, to honor the LORD.
